title: PvP Duel: Draft & Fight Your Friends
description:
[h1]Slay your friends, not just the Spire.[/h1]
Two players. Two decks built on the spot. One survives.

[b]PvP Duel[/b] adds a [b]Duel[/b] button to the main menu and turns the game's co-op into a head-to-head fight between you and a friend.

[h2]⚔ Draft your weapon[/h2]
Before the first blow, both players build their deck live:
[list]
[*][b]10 cards[/b] hand-picked from your character's whole card pool. Commons, uncommons, rares: you choose the combo.
[*][b]5 relics[/b], one out of three each round. Every pick shapes your plan.
[/list]
No luck of the draw on the way in: pure deckbuilding, then straight into battle.

[h2]🔥 Then fight[/h2]
[list]
[*]Your opponent stands across the arena as [b]their own character[/b], with their real HP, block and powers.
[*][b]Alternating turns[/b]: the host strikes first, then it's their move. Your block holds through their turn.
[*]Everything hits for real: Vulnerable, Weak, poison, Thorns, AoE, potions.
[*]Last one standing gets [b]Victory![/b] Rage-quit? That's a win for whoever stayed.
[/list]

[h2]🌐 How to play[/h2]
[list]
[*]Both players subscribe, start the game and accept the mods popup.
[*]Host: [b]Duel → Host[/b]. The panel shows your IP (ZeroTier / Hamachi / LAN) with a [b]Copy[/b] button: send it to your friend.
[*]Friend: [b]Duel[/b] → paste the IP → [b]Join[/b].
[*]Pick characters, draft, fight!
[/list]
Works over LAN, Hamachi or ZeroTier. The host needs [b]UDP port 33771[/b] open. Both players need the same game version and the same mod list.

Duel runs are not saved and don't count for stats or unlocks.
Built on the game's own co-op connection and turn sync.
